context: A mom and her young son talk about a busy park visit
purpose: Teach: いっそう/気が付い/解ら/みえ/陽気/続々/絶えず/浮上

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ママ、見て見て！公園に子どもたちが続々と来てるよ！
lines.en: Mom, look look! Kids keep arriving at the park one after another!
lines.style: Excited child tugging mom's sleeve while pointing around

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 本当ね、今日はいっそう賑やかだわ。みんな陽気に走り回ってるね。
lines.en: Really, it's even livelier today. Everyone's running around so cheerfully.
lines.style: Warm motherly tone marveling at the bustling park atmosphere

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: あっ、気が付いたら砂場がいっぱい！どうしてかな、よく解らないよ。
lines.en: Oh, before I knew it, the sandbox is packed! Why is that, I don't really get it.
lines.style: Child expressing innocent confusion with curious wide-eyed wonder

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: ほら、向こうにイベントのテントがみえるでしょ。あれが原因かもね。
lines.en: Look, you can see event tents over there, right? That might be the reason.
lines.style: Patient explanatory tone gently directing son's gaze forward

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: わぁ、風船が絶えず空に飛んでいくよ！一個ふわっと浮上した！
lines.en: Wow, balloons keep flying into the sky non-stop! One just floated up!
lines.style: Child shouting with wonder while pointing up at sky

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: 綺麗ねぇ。ママも子どもの頃を思い出しちゃうな。
lines.en: How pretty. It reminds me of when I was a kid too.
lines.style: Soft nostalgic tone with a gentle smile in her voice

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: ねぇ、あのアイス屋さんも並んでる！僕も食べたいなぁ。
lines.en: Hey, that ice cream stand has a line too! I wanna eat some.
lines.style: Pleading child voice with hopeful tugging on mother's hand

lines.speaker: yumiko_mom
lines.jp: じゃあ並ぼうか。せっかくだから、今日は満喫しましょう。
lines.en: Then let's line up. Since we came all this way, let's fully enjoy today.
lines.style: Cheerful agreeable mom embracing the special outing with son
